test_framework: None (no test files exist in this project)
test_command: No tests exist; verification is build-only
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run build' to confirm no compilation errors. 2. Verify the firebase.js and firestoreService.js files are syntactically correct. 3. Confirm App.jsx still imports and uses localStorage as before.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode - full npm install and external package access available. Node.js 22 available via nvm.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md exists. Keep changes minimal and non-breaking.
key_patterns: Single large App.jsx (5000+ lines) contains all state management. Uses useState/useRef/useEffect hooks. Save logic: useEffect watches [workspaces, activeTab, nextId, tasks, taskGroups, cardTaskLinks, initialized, activeProjectId], updates projects state, then debounced (500ms) localStorage.setItem('nexus-app-state', JSON.stringify(currentProjects)). Also a separate useEffect for storedPassword changes. A saveTimerRef is used for debouncing. projectsRef keeps projects in sync for the debounced write callback. Initialization loads from localStorage in a useEffect with empty deps array.
directory_structure: Root: index.html, package.json, vite.config.js, tailwind/postcss configs. src/: App.jsx (main component, 5000+ lines), MiniMap.jsx, TaskPanel.jsx, main.jsx (entry point), index.css. public/: vite.svg.
